# mobius-gateway 0.16.47

Includes framework 0.16.47 with bounded repeated tool execution and immutable validated checkpoint saves. Session readiness and profile loading overlap independent Git and provider requests while preserving local database order and error precedence. Modified-file listing runs independent Git queries together; untracked diff totals and idle-session queries use bounded concurrency.

Protocol 97, config 29, Bot catalog 10, checkpoint 21 and SQLite schema 14 are unchanged. No record conversion is required from 0.16.46.
